catalog.roles is a {guildId: count} map (the brief said 'count per guild'); a missing or invalid count makes that building UNAVAILABLE with null counts.
Without a catalog the model has no districts or buildings (no ids exist to draw, none are invented); only the tower and a notice are rendered.
Live runs without a catalog guildId are not attributed to a building (no role-to-guild mapping is supplied); they are counted only in totals.unattributedActiveRuns.
